\]

\[
P(x) = \prod_{k=1}^{100} x\left(1 + \frac{3k}{x}\right) = x^{100} \prod_{k=1}^{100} \left(1 + \frac{3k}{x}\right)
\]

Thus:

\[
P(x)^{1/100} = x \left[ \prod_{k=1}^{100} \left(1 + \frac{3k}{x}\right) \right]^{1/100}
\]

So:

\[
P(x)^{1/100} - x = x \left[ \left( \prod_{k=1}^{100} \left(1 + \frac{3k}{x}\right) \right)^{1/100} - 1 \right]
\]

For large \(x\), we can use the expansion \(\ln(1+u) \approx u\) for small \(u\). Let:

\[
A(x) = \prod_{k=1}^{100} \left(1 + \frac{3k}{x}\right)

Therefore:

\[
P(x)^{1/100} - x \approx x \left(1 + \frac{151.5}{x} - 1\right) = 151.5
\]

So the limit is:

151.5 = \frac{303}{2}
